offlineProtection.explainerLead: You must keep your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) on and connected to the internet during service.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen goes off, the device loses internet, or you switch to another website, offline protection steps in — by pausing ordering or turning auto-accept off, whichever you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Please keep your dashboard or kitchen screen (KDS) on and online during service, otherwise offline protection may step in.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection switched on.

To keep orders coming in, your screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, offline protection steps in in the way you chose.

Please make sure “Screen on” is on on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Switch off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders will still come in — customers may place orders you cannot see. Only switch it off when you have a connection you can trust.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to incoming orders when your device drops offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If your device loses its connection, this stops orders coming in while you cannot see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this van loses its connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online ordering
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers cannot order until you are back online.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep taking orders and confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is turned off, so customers can still order but nothing is confirmed automatically. You will confirm each order when you are back online — and any order still waiting will be rejected automatically after the time you chose, with an e-mail sent to tell the customer.
kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can make at the same time, across all the categories you ticked. Each category’s own batch size still applies on top of this.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all the selected categories, so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. Your mains will still be limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave it at the infinity symbol for no limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work properly, set a prep time and batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without them, capacity cannot know how long items take to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Please add a van in Settings › Truck settings to set your kitchen capacity.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only choose collection times you can keep up with.
kitchenCapacity.sameForAll: Same kitchen capacity for all vans?
kitchenCapacity.confirmBody: All vans will use the kitchen capacity of van: {van}. Each van’s own numbers will be replaced.
kitchenCapacity.colCountsTitle: Which categories count toward the total capacity. Cooked categories always count; tick instant ones (sides, dips, drinks) to include them.
kitchenCapacity.countsLocked: Cooked — always counts (its prep time and batch size set the pace)
kitchenCapacity.countsNoCap: Set a capacity first to choose which categories count
kitchenCapacity.countsUnavailable: Not available until the database is updated
kitchenCapacity.countsTick: Tick to include this instant category (sides, dips, drinks) in the shared limit for each window
kitchenCapacity.setCapacityFirst: Set a capacity first to choose which categories count.

kitchenCapacity.prepPerOrderHelp: How long it takes to prepare one order
kitchenCapacity.itemsAtATimeHelp: How many items your kitchen can cook at the same time
kitchenCapacity.instantNote: Instant items do not count toward kitchen capacity — customers get them straight away.
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.label: Allow customers to cancel orders
settingsCopy.allowCancellation.sentence: Customers can cancel up to <select></select> before their pickup time
settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Auto-accept orders
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. It only confirms when the kitchen still has capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still need confirming.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: Order-ready step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Show a “Mark ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately, on each device. Customers get an e-mail every time an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still switch it on or off for a single event on its dashboard.
settingsCopy.buzzers.label: Do you hand out buzzers for collection?
settingsCopy.buzzers.help: Record which buzzer you gave each customer, so you know who to look for when their food is ready.
settingsCopy.buzzers.countLabel: How many buzzers do you have?
whereYouTrade.stepHeading: Where is your food truck based?
whereYouTrade.stepIntro: This sets your currency, prices, time zone and phone number format. The country cannot be changed later, because it is linked to your card payments.
whereYouTrade.countryGuessed: We guessed this from where you are. Please change it if it is wrong.
whereYouTrade.townQuestion: Town or city where you are based
whereYouTrade.saveFailed: Could not save settings — please try again.
stockCopy.defaultScopeNote: Default for every event. To set a different amount for one event, change it on that event’s dashboard — events you have already set there keep their own amount.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.perDishBod: Check each dish and confirm its allergens. Customers see per-dish tags along with an allergen summary card made from those tags.
managePrimitives.allergenMode.cardBody: Upload or paste a single allergen card (PDF, image or text), shown as it is. The per-dish tags stay hidden.

manageSettings.getApp.title: Download the app
manageSettings.getApp.body: The kitchen app runs your service on a phone or tablet — and it is the only way to keep taking orders when you lose mobile signal. Free with your account, on iPhone, iPad and Android.

manageSettings.schedule.title: Your schedule
manageSettings.schedule.autoDesc: Tell us where you post your schedule and we will check it for you, sending any events we find for you to approve. This must be your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageSettings.schedule.eitherWay: Either way, if we find your events somewhere else, we will still send them to you to approve. Nothing goes live until you confirm.
manageSettings.schedule.wherePost: Where do you post your schedule?
manageSettings.schedule.checkingHelp: This can take up to 2 minutes — please keep this page open and do not close the browser tab.

manageSettings.qr.domainNotLive: This QR code takes customers to your HatchGrab ordering page. If you set up your own web address later, the same QR code will take them there instead — you will not need to print a new code.
manageSettings.qr.printHelp: Print or display this code so customers can scan and pre-order. Put it at your counter, on your van, or share it online.

manageReports.accounts.help: Sales are counted on the day of the event. Gross income is what customers paid. Net income is what is left after refunds and tax.
manageReports.accounts.taxNone: No tax rate is set for your food truck yet, so tax is not calculated here.

manageReports.accounts.downloadHelp: Two spreadsheet files: one row for each order, and one row for each event. They open in Excel, Numbers, Xero and QuickBooks.
